title: Cross-Facility Patient Identity Match with Payer Denial
scenario_text:
**Epic (Lakewood Campus) -- Patient Record:**
MRN: VHP-L-4492817 | Name: Margaret A. Kowalski | DOB: 03/14/1948 | SSN: ***-**-6271 | Primary Insurance: BlueCross MN PPO | Subscriber ID: XWB992014487 | Last encounter: 02/18/2026 (hip arthroplasty, DRG 470)

**Cerner RevCycle -- Claim Denial (received 03/11/2026):**
Claim #: CLM-2026-00881247 | Billed: $42,300 | DOS: 02/18/2026 | Denial Code: CO-4 ("The procedure code is inconsistent with the modifier used or a required modifier is missing") | ERA Payer Remark: "Duplicate service -- patient received identical procedure at network facility on 01/22/2026. See prior auth PA-8841203."

**Epic (Riverside Campus -- merged entity) -- Patient Record:**
MRN: RMC-0087341 | Name: Maggie Kowalski-Dent | DOB: 03/14/1948 | SSN: ***-**-6271 | Primary Insurance: BCBS Minnesota | Subscriber ID: XWB992014487 | Encounter 01/22/2026: Right knee arthroscopy (CPT 29881), Dr. Pham

**Health Cloud CRM -- Care Coordination Note (02/01/2026):**
Account: Margaret Kowalski | Note by RN Care Coordinator: "Pt called re: upcoming L hip replacement at Lakewood. Confirmed she is same pt as Riverside MRN ending in 7341 -- name discrepancy due to recent marriage. MPI merge request submitted 01/28. Awaiting HIM review."

**Slack -- #rev-cycle-denials (unofficial channel, 03/12/2026, 9:47 AM):**
@jenna.park: Got a CO-4 on the Kowalski arthroplasty but the ERA remark says duplicate. That's not a CO-4, that's a CO-18 issue. Payer applied wrong denial code.
@michelle.torres: Was the MPI merge completed before the claim dropped?
@jenna.park: Checking... no, HIM still has it in queue. Claim went out with the old Lakewood MRN only.
@michelle.torres: That explains it. Payer saw two different patients with same subscriber ID getting ortho procedures 4 weeks apart. Flag it -- we need the merge done before appeal.
[Thread: 3 additional replies, then silence]

**SharePoint -- /contracts/payers/BCBS-MN/VHP-Amendment-2024.pdf (last modified 08/2024):**
Section 9.4: "Claims for services rendered at any Vantage Health Partners facility shall be adjudicated under this agreement regardless of which campus-specific TIN was used for submission, provided the rendering provider holds active credentials within the VHP medical staff."
question: What is the correct primary action to resolve this denial and ensure successful reimbursement?

contributor.name: Michelle Torres
contributor.title: Revenue Cycle Director
contributor.domain_expertise: Claims management, denial resolution, patient identity matching, payer contract interpretation

choices: Complete the MPI merge first to unify MRNs, then appeal citing Section 9.4 of the BCBS-MN amendment and the distinct CPT codes proving non-duplicate services on a single unified patient record
Submit a corrected claim with modifier 59 (distinct procedural service) to override the duplicate edit, referencing both encounters as distinct anatomical sites
Refile the claim under the Riverside Campus TIN since the payer contract amendment covers all VHP facilities, bypassing the MPI issue entirely
Appeal the CO-4 denial citing incorrect denial reason code, as the procedure was a hip arthroplasty (DRG 470) not a duplicate of the knee arthroscopy (CPT 29881) -- no MPI merge needed
